subject.title: [Bug]: Tool JSON Schema patternProperties causes 400 errors on BytePlus Ark (doubao) — schema cleaning should be universal, not provider-specific

question: Should BytePlus/Ark `patternProperties` failures be fixed through provider-owned compatibility metadata or by changing the default schema policy for all non-Anthropic providers?
rationale: Both paths can address the reported 400, but the universal scrubber changes schema behavior for every non-Anthropic provider and repository policy treats provider routing and compatibility defaults as upgrade-sensitive.

options.title: Provider-owned BytePlus/Ark compat
options.body: Add `patternProperties` to the BytePlus/Ark provider compatibility metadata on the active normalizer path, preserving other providers' current schema behavior.

options.title: Universal non-Anthropic scrubber
options.body: Strip `patternProperties` by default for all non-Anthropic providers, accepting broader compatibility risk in exchange for a single global rule.

options.title: Configurable provider flag
options.body: Add or document a provider compat flag for unsupported tool-schema keywords, which is more flexible but adds configuration surface.

recommendation.title: Provider-owned BytePlus/Ark compat
recommendation.body: Add `patternProperties` to the BytePlus/Ark provider compatibility metadata on the active normalizer path, preserving other providers' current schema behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history on tool-schema compatibility and provider model-compat cleanup.
